comment: Question bank. priority 1 must be answered before handoff; 2 should be; 3 nice to have. Topics map to PRD sections.

core.text: In one sentence, what should be possible that isn't today?
Who uses it, and who else is affected (approvers, admins, support)?
How will you know it worked? Name a measurable outcome.
What is explicitly out of scope for the first version?
Hard constraints: deadline, budget, platforms, compliance, data residency?
Which existing systems must it work with, and who owns them?
What would make this fail, or make people refuse to use it?
What does a great first week look like for a new user?

web-app.text: Which devices and browsers must it support?
How do users sign in, and is there an identity provider to use?
What data is stored, and how sensitive is it?
Expected users and peak requests per minute in year one?

data-platform.text: Which sources feed it, at what volume and freshness?
Who consumes the data: analysts, applications, models?
What are the retention, lineage and privacy rules?
Which decisions or reports will it make faster or more reliable?

ai-agent.text: What may the agent do on its own, and what must a person approve?
Which tools, data and systems may it touch, with what permissions?
How will you evaluate it: test cases, success rate, cost per task?
What evidence must each run leave for audit?

cli-tool.text: Who runs it, where (laptop, CI), and how often?
How is it installed and upgraded, and on which operating systems?
Which task should take one command instead of several?
